title: Notifications: Keep Users Informed in the Admin, by Email and SMS | Orchard Core
description:
Users miss what happens on a site when nothing tells them. Sending a message by hand to each person does not keep up with the events of a site.

The Notifications module stores a notification for each user in a notification center, shows it from a bell in the admin, and can also send it by email or SMS as each user chooses. A workflow sends the notifications without code.

In this video:
• How notifications reach users: the notification center, the methods and the senders
• Enabling the Notifications, Email Notifications and SMS Notifications features
• Sending a notification with a workflow
• The notification bell in the top bar
• The notification center: search, filters and bulk actions
• The notification preferences of each user
• What email and SMS deliveries send and need
